Filmmaker James Fox returns to Danny Jones with what he calls proof that the military held a live alien in Brazil. The case is the Varginha event, in which locals reported strange beings after a crash. Fox has filmed the witnesses for years.

Fox lays out the reports from Varginha, the hospital staff, and the troops said to have moved a being. He argues the proof now goes past rumor. Jones asks what would at last settle the case. Listeners get the full Brazil file from its best known teller. The library files the talk as an archive record, without a verdict.

Writer and filmmaker Mike Cernovich joins Tucker Carlson for a strange, wide talk. The title lists his themes: Donald Trump, demons, and hidden federal agents. Few guests mix faith and politics quite like this.

Cernovich argues that agents hide inside the conservative movement itself. He warns friends to watch who urges them toward rash acts. He also speaks of spiritual evil as a real force in public life. Carlson lets the claims run and tests them. The episode will draw listeners who like their politics mixed with mystery and warning.
